name: upper-midwest-arthropods
label: Upper Midwest (MN, WI, IA, ND, SD, MB, ON): insects, spiders and harvestmen

groups.label: spiders
groups.note: spiders (Araneae) and harvestmen (Opiliones); a cut of their own, as they have about a thirtieth of the insects' records

filtersNote: observations only: in Ontario 72% of the open insect records are DNA-barcoded trap samples and specimens (iBOL 763 k MATERIAL_SAMPLE, Centre for Biodiversity Genomics 377 k PRESERVED_SPECIMEN), mostly midges, gall midges and parasitoid wasps no one photographs, and with them the most recorded species are those of the malaise traps; a photo classifier wants the species people see and photograph
minRecordsNote: the cut that keeps about 1300 of the most observed species: with observations only, 1070 insects have 50 or more records in some region, 1881 have 20, and the list wants the commonly photographed ones (Ontario's 286 k observations set most of them); spiders have about a thirtieth of the insects' records, so their cut is 10 (116 species; 73 at 20)
